summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" formatter and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True when written and False when not a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Per instructions, no tests or Black were run, so formatting and test results are unverified. Note: the spec's "never raises" conflicts with "do not catch wrapper exceptions"; I followed the no-catch rule.
